fusions.name: Anchor Line
fusions.desc: Casts a stone anchor on a chain into an enemy for 13 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds, and hauls you up to 7 tiles to it.

fusions.name: Linked Tremor
fusions.desc: A rattling shock through the ground deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles of you. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Hand Over Hand
fusions.desc: You drop anchor and haul on your chains, pulling up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fettered Footing
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.
